import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap, flow;
        long cost;

        Edge(int to, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    int n;
    List<List<Edge>> g;
    long[] dist;
    int[] prevv, preve;
    boolean[] inq;

    MinCostFlow(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        g = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    void addEdge(int v, int u, long cap, long cost) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(u, g.get(u).size(), cap, cost);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size() - 1, 0, -cost);
        g.get(v).add(e1);
        g.get(u).add(e2);
    }

    public long[] minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        long flow = 0, totalCost = 0;

        while (Long.MAX_VALUE / 2) {
            dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            prevv = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(prevv, -1);
            preve = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(preve, -1);
            inq = new boolean[n];

            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            inq[s] = true;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                inq[v] = false;

                for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                    if (e.cap <= e.flow) continue;

                    if (dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;

                        if (!inq[e.to]) {
                            q.offer(e.to);
                            inq[e.to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            long add = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge e = g.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]);
                add = Math.min(add, e.cap - e.flow);
            }

            flow += add;

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge e = g.get(prevv[v]).get(preve[v]);
                e.flow += add;
                g.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= add;
                totalCost += add * e.cost;
            }
        }

        return new long[]{flow, totalCost}
    }
